# Your Daily Briefing — Friday 24 October

Yesterday was a tough one honestly. With only 1.8 hours of sleep and just 3,682 steps, your body didn't get the rest or movement it needed. You burned 2,409 kcal though, so your metabolism is ticking along nicely even on quiet days.

That HRV of 60ms is the number that stands out most — you're sitting well below your 98-121ms baseline, which is a clear signal your nervous system is under real stress. Combined with the sleep deprivation, today is not the day to push hard. Swap any planned intensity for a gentle walk or full rest. Forcing it now risks digging a deeper hole.

Prioritise sleep above everything today — even nutrition. But when you do eat, hit that 175g protein target as it'll support recovery without excess calories. A simple early dinner and screens off by 9pm could genuinely turn things around overnight.
